summary: generator parameters: hosts (name template and parents with optional vars), layers (lists of values), plugin, and use_extra_vars (2.21+).
questions: How do I set variables on generated parent groups?
What are layers in the generator inventory plugin?

answer_card.title: generator inventory parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `plugin` (required): `ansible.builtin.generator` or `generator`
- `hosts`: `name` template expanded over the cartesian product of layers; `parents` list of groups (each with `name`, optional `parents`, and optional `vars`)
- `layers`: dict of layer name to list of values
- `use_extra_vars` (default false, 2.21+): merge extra vars for composition
